text:
maya: heads up — AcmeCorp + HealthNet pushed back on tracing hooks. they need per-route cost + error-slice views before they’ll sign off for Dedicated onboarding. can we scope a compact deliverable for the next sprint? :thinking_face:

ton y: we can do a lightweight per-route cost table + sample traces for top 10 routes. not doing full-span histograms in MVP. estimate: 4 dev days + 2 infra days.

ben: quick question — are we reusing the existing token-attribution pipeline for per-route cost? if so we can sample, if not it’s extra work to attribute tokens to routes.

maya: goal is fast beta for customers. minimum acceptance: route-level cost heatmap, error-rate by route, and one-click open trace link from the route view. no span-level analytics in MVP.

sarah: both customers said this is a gating feature for their Dedicated rollout. they need stable-ish data + docs. they want a weekly status update.

tony: for sampling i propose deterministic reservoir sampling per route (thresholded by call volume) + sticky sample IDs for correlated traces. i’ll draft a short sampling plan.

maya: launch criteria (proposal): 1) route cost numbers within 10% of offline batch baseline for common routes; 2) error-rate signal stable for 24h (no noisy alerts); 3) docs + runbook published; 4) one customer acceptance test passing. owners: tony (impl), ben (infra), maya (customer + docs).

ben: infra asks: need an ephemeral debug pipeline (1x r5-large) for two weeks to validate attribution, and a billing-tag change to propagate route ids. ops said tentative OK but need ticket.

devex-bot: Reminder — add feature note to SDK changelog and update release notes template (action: @maya).

sarah: customers also asked for a simple 'what-if' slider showing cost impact of batching/quantization at route-level. stretch goal for MVP-B.

maya: proposed split: MVP-A = cost + error per-route + trace-link (customer beta). MVP-B = what-if slider + sampling controls + richer error buckets. target MVP-A for sprint 12.

tony: i’ll open a spike card for sampling & attribution (2d). if spike shows reuse possible, impl drops to ~3d.

maya: ok. next sync: Fri 10am to lock acceptance tests. action items: tony — sampling spike; ben — infra ticket + ephemeral instance; maya — docs draft + customer comms; sarah — schedule customer acceptance sessions.

ben: adding tickets to the board now. tagging infra and billing.

sarah: thanks — i’ll tee up the two customers and draft acceptance scenarios.

maya: great — thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
